## Navigation & Work
- [Home Page](https://samueljohn.vercel.app/): Main interactive portfolio showcase with engineering tech stack, core services, and client testimonials.

- [About](https://samueljohn.vercel.app/about-us): Profile, technical competencies, tools, and background.
- [Blog](https://samueljohn.vercel.app/blog): Engineering insights, modern web development, and design patterns.
- [Contact](https://samueljohn.vercel.app/contact): Project inquiries, freelance contracts, and engineering collaborations.

## Technical Capabilities
- Frontend: React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, Next.js, Framer Motion, GSAP
- Backend: Python, FastAPI, Django, Node.js, REST APIs, SQL databases
- Core Focus: Web Performance, Responsive Architecture, Accessibility (WCAG AA), Core Web Vitals
